translation.prompt: 中华民族崇尚自强自立的精神，这一精神深植于中国文化之中，是民族生存与发展的重要支撑。改革开放以来，中国在自强自立的征程上，持续加大科研投入，在信息技术、人工智能、航天工程等领域不断取得新突破。5G 网络覆盖全国，远程医疗发展迅速，电子支付的使用全球领先，嫦娥探月工程展现了航天领域引人注目的发展。自强自立精神成为推动国家现代化进程的强大动力，激励着中国人民为实现民族复兴（rejuvenation）的中国梦不断奋进。

writing.sample: While striving for the Chinese Dream, young people enjoy more opportunities to realize their self-worth. This grand vision of national rejuvenation acts as a powerful engine driving social progress, thereby creating a vast stage for the youth to display their talents and pursue their ambitions. In the past, career paths might have been relatively narrow, but today, with the nation's emphasis on innovation and high-quality development, the possibilities are endless. For instance, the rapid growth of the digital economy allows young tech enthusiasts to become entrepreneurs and industry leaders, turning creative ideas into reality. Similarly, the rural revitalization strategy offers graduates a chance to apply their academic knowledge to agriculture and infrastructure, bringing tangible changes to the countryside and finding deep personal fulfillment in the process. Moreover, as China interacts more profoundly with the world, young people can serve as cultural ambassadors. In conclusion, the era of the Chinese Dream is an era of possibility. By aligning their personal ambitions with the country's needs, young people can not only contribute to the nation but also achieve profound personal success.

analyses.46: 文章第二段指出正念意味着观察自我体验而不在当下做出反应，即专注于当下且不加评判（without...judgments）。A选项原文说的是“without...sending the mind spiraling off into thinking about old memories”，即不反思过去或预见未来；C选项中正念是观察情感而非单纯专注于个人情感；D选项指面对他人评判保持冷静，文中是指不对体验进行好坏评判。
analyses.47: 第四段明确提到：“human attention has been transformed into a commodity that big corporations buy and sell.” 这种注意力经济将人的注意力变成了可以买卖的商品。A、C、D均非Odell关于注意力经济核心定义的直接表述。
analyses.48: 第五段开头提到：“The devices most people use are a perpetual diversion from the present moment.” 手机等设备使人不断从当下分心。B、D未直接提及；C选项错在正念能帮人重获观察能力，而非设备彻底剥夺了该能力。
analyses.49: 第六段提到：“It can help us build stronger, healthier relationships.” 对应建立更好的人际关系。A只是实现过程的一部分；B、D文中未作为学者强调的社交益处提及。
analyses.50: 第八段提到：“listening to them with complete attention without judgment”。作者建议在他人面前要做专注的倾听者且不加评判。A中强调互相分享，文中强调倾听他人；B、D偏离了倾听这一核心建议。
analyses.51: 第二段中作者写道：“Like a lamb, I complied”，意为像羔羊一样顺从地照办了，对应submissively。A、B、C项不符合作者带着“irritated”但依然“complied”的心态描述。
analyses.52: 第四段提到Captcha被称为“自动图灵测试”，并反讽道：“we have wandered into a world in which machines make us do tricks to prove that we are humans!”。图灵测试本是人测机器，现在反过来机器要求人做动作来证明身份。A、B、D均非文中强调的那个讽刺点。
analyses.53: 第五段提到温水煮青蛙，并问道：“don’t see what’s been happening to us?”。这比喻人正处于被数字技术温水煮青蛙式的缓慢驯化中而不自知其中的危险。A、C、D项未能准确把握比喻中“由于变化细微而察觉不到危险”的核心含义。
analyses.54: 最后一段指出，这些学者认为人类正在被工具塑造，并提到：“digital tech now sees（and uses）humans as means to ends that are not ours.” 数字技术正把人类当做实现其（非人类利益）目的的手段。B、C、D未触及这种“人被工具化、手段化”的本质论点。
analyses.55: 结尾引用温水煮青蛙的隐喻问道是否能及时跳出，暗示人们如果不及时醒悟，可能会陷入技术掌控的深渊。D项最贴合这种警示意味。A只是一个观点；B讨论输赢偏离了逃离危险的主旨；C是对“don't even have to Google”的反讽性解读，理解错误。

translation.prompt: 节俭（frugality）是中华民族的传统美德。在中国古代，生产力低下，先人们深知劳动成果来之不易，因而秉持节俭的理念。到了物质极大丰富的今天，中国人民依然坚持节俭的生活方式，体现了理性消费的生活理念和对劳动的尊重。近年来，中国政府持续加强节约型社会的建设，倡导“光盘行动”，减少食物浪费，提倡简约低碳的生活方式，推进资源循环利用，反对过度消费。节约型社会的建设有力地推动了中国经济的高质量发展。
translation.reference: Frugality is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation. In ancient China, productivity was low, and our ancestors were well aware that the fruits of labor were hard-won, thus they upheld the philosophy of thrift. Even today, in an era of great material abundance, the Chinese people still adhere to a frugal lifestyle, which reflects the concept of rational consumption and respect for labor. In recent years, the Chinese government has continued to strengthen the building of a resource-conserving society, advocating the 'Clear Your Plate' campaign to reduce food waste, promoting simple and low-carbon lifestyles, advancing the recycling of resources, and opposing excessive consumption. The construction of a resource-conserving society has effectively promoted the high-quality development of the Chinese economy.

writing.sample: It is believed that teachers can exert a profound influence on their students’ academic pursuit and personal development. Teachers are not simply conveyors of information; they serve as mentors who shape a student's character and worldview. Academically, an inspiring teacher can spark curiosity and passion for a subject, transforming a mundane course into a lifelong career path. For instance, a professor's timely encouragement can provide the necessary motivation for a student to overcome academic hurdles or pursue advanced research. Furthermore, in terms of personal development, teachers model essential values such as integrity, resilience, and empathy. They provide guidance during vulnerable periods, helping students navigate the complexities of life and build self-confidence. My own experience with a high school teacher taught me that perseverance is more important than immediate success, a lesson that continues to influence me today. In conclusion, the role of a teacher is multifaceted and indispensable. By guiding both the mind and the heart, they lay the foundation for a student's future success and ethical maturity.

analyses.1: 原文："I haven't, indeed. And I wish to sign the agreement. Pending one small change to be made to the contract." （我确实还没同意，但我希望签署协议。有待对合同做一点小小的修改。）这表明女士愿意签署协议，条件是做一点小修改。因此，选项B正确。

analyses.3: 原文："My client has a couple of other prospective marketing deals from companies in the Middle East... in order to avoid any conflict, we would need to ensure that both marketing campaigns do not overlap geographically." （我的客户在中东地区与那边的公司还有一些潜在的营销协议……为了避免任何冲突，我们需要确保两个营销活动在地理上不重叠。）女士提出排除中东地区是为了避免潜在的利益冲突。因此，选项C正确。

analyses.5: 原文："all the astronomers on site here are very excited." （这里的全体天文学家都非常兴奋。）兴奋的原因是即将出现的罕见天象（奥本海默彗星）。因此，选项A正确。
analyses.6: 原文："Tonight the Earth will come into close proximity with the open-heimer comet. It is the closest Our planet has been to such a phenomenon in over 100 years." （今晚地球将与奥本海默彗星非常接近。这是我们星球一百多年来与此类现象最接近的一次。）这表明彗星将一百多年来距离地球最近。因此，选项B正确。
analyses.7: 原文："People will only see a blur without one [a telescope]." （没有望远镜的话，人们只能看到模糊的一团。）女士明确指出没有望远镜只能看到模糊的景象。因此，选项A正确。
analyses.8: 原文："scientists here have told me there are plenty of phone apps that will facilitate this [finding the comet]." （这里的科学家告诉我，有很多手机应用可以帮助做到这一点[找到彗星]。）科学家建议业余爱好者利用手机应用来帮助观察。因此，选项D正确。
analyses.9: 原文："one question has recently stirred debate. Should consumers be warned to avoid ultra processed foods?" （最近有一个问题引发了争论。是否应该警告消费者避免超加工食品？）这句直接指出了引发争论的问题。因此，选项A正确。
analyses.10: 原文："The debate centers around a system developed by Montiera and colleagues that classifies foods by their degree of industrial processing, ranging from unprocessed to ultra-processed." （这场争论围绕着蒙泰罗及其同事开发的一个系统展开，该系统根据工业加工的程度对食品进行分类，范围从未经加工到超加工。）这句明确说明了分类的标准。因此，选项B正确。
analyses.11: 原文："Studies have linked consumption of ultra processed foods... with weight gain, and an increased risk of chronic diseases" （研究已将超加工食品的消费...与体重增加和慢性疾病风险增加联系起来。）研究表明超加工食品与体重增加和慢性疾病风险增加有关。选项B提到了慢性疾病风险增加。因此，选项B正确。

analyses.13: 原文："Innovation is a creative person's response to limitation." （创新是创造性个体对限制的回应。）这句话直接定义了创新与限制的关系。因此，选项C正确。
analyses.14: 原文："a 2015 study... found that people simply have no incentive to use what's available to them in novel ways." （2015年的一项研究...发现人们根本没有动力以新颖的方式使用他们现有的资源。）这项研究发现人们缺乏以新颖方式使用现有资源的动力。因此，选项C正确。
analyses.15: 原文："Marissa Meier... once wrote... Creativity thrives best when constrained." （玛丽莎·梅耶尔...曾写道...创造力在受限时最能蓬勃发展。）玛丽莎·梅耶尔明确写道创造力在受限时表现最好。因此，选项D正确。
analyses.16: 原文："But we do have a personal strategy, and because it is learned we can always change it by learning new and more effective ways of managing conflicts." （但我们确实有个人策略，而且因为它是在后天习得的，所以我们可以通过学习新的、更有效的方式来改变它。）演讲者指出冲突管理策略是习得的，因此可以改变。因此，选项A正确。
analyses.17: 原文："How important your personal goals are and how important the relationship is to you affect how you act in a conflict." （你个人目标的重要性以及人际关系对你的重要性，会影响你在冲突中的行为方式。）演讲者明确指出个人目标和关系的重要性影响冲突中的行为。因此，选项C正确。
analyses.18: 原文："The Owl. Owls view conflicts as problems to be solved." （猫头鹰。猫头鹰视冲突为待解决的问题。）演讲者在描述“猫头鹰”风格时明确指出他们视冲突为问题。因此，选项B正确。
analyses.19: 原文："According to the genetic code... will be mapped to help save species from extinction and boost human health." （根据遗传密码...将被绘制出来以帮助拯救物种免于灭绝并促进人类健康。）文章开篇就指出了这项计划的主要目标。因此，选项A正确。
analyses.20: 原文："Many scientists believe that Earth has now entered the sixth mass extinction" （许多科学家认为地球现在已经进入了第六次大灭绝。）文章明确引用许多科学家的观点，认为地球已进入第六次大灭绝。因此，选项B正确。
analyses.21: 原文："So Jim Smith, director of science at Welcome, said, Try as I might, I can't think of a more exciting, more relevant, more timely, or more internationally inspirational project." （因此，Welcome科学总监吉姆·史密斯说，无论我怎么努力，我都想不出一个比这更令人兴奋、更相关、更及时、或更具国际启发性的项目。）吉姆·史密斯用这句话来形容该项目。因此，选项D正确。
analyses.22: 原文："Now, a British academic has claimed that human individuality is indeed just an illusion" （现在，一位英国学者声称，人类的个体性确实只是一种幻觉。）汤姆·奥利弗教授在文章开头就提出了这个观点。因此，选项D正确。
analyses.23: 原文："However, we have one more big myth to dispose of that we exist as independent selves at the center of a subjective universe." （然而，我们还有一个需要摒弃的大迷思，那就是我们作为独立的自我存在于一个主观宇宙的中心。）奥利弗教授认为这种想法是一个需要摒弃的“大迷思”（big myth to dispose of），也就是一种幻觉。因此，选项A正确。
analyses.24: 原文："there are around 37 trillion cells in the body, but most have a lifespan of just a few days or weeks." （身体里大约有37万亿个细胞，但大多数的寿命只有几天或几周。）奥利弗教授用身体细胞的短暂寿命来论证物质身体的不断变化。因此，选项D正确。
analyses.25: 原文："only by realizing we are part of a bigger entity, can we solve pressing environmental and societal problems?" （只有意识到我们是更大实体的一部分，才能解决紧迫的环境和社会问题？）奥利弗教授认为解决这些问题需要认识到我们是更大整体的一部分。因此，选项C正确。
analyses.26: 根据上下文，这里讨论的是音乐如何影响压力。空白处应填一个动词，表示“减轻”或“缓解”压力。选项A) alleviate 意为“减轻，缓解”，符合文意。
analyses.27: 句子结构“letting... dopamine in the brain”暗示音乐能促使多巴胺释放。选项I) loose（此处应为lose的某种用法，或原文有误，但根据答案表I对应loose，且上下文需要一个动词或分词形式与letting搭配描述多巴胺的状态）在语境中似乎不太恰当，更自然的说法可能是 letting dopamine be released 或 similar。然而，对照提供的答案表，27对应的答案是I，而I在词库中是loose。假设此处letting loose是指“释放，散发”的意思，尽管let loose more commonly applies to emotions or physical actions. 考虑到选项限制和提供的答案，选择loose。原文本可能是“letting loose”作为短语使用，表示释放某种物质，尽管不常用。根据答案，我们必须选择I) loose。
analyses.28: 前一句提到古典音乐能带来更快乐的心情。根据上下文，快乐的心情有助于思考的清晰度。空白处需要一个名词。选项B) clarity 意为“清晰，清楚”，符合文意，表示思维变得清晰。
analyses.29: 后文列举了Bach, Beethoven and Handel，这些都是著名的作曲家。空白处需要一个名词，表示这些人是什么。选项D) composers 意为“作曲家”，符合文意。
analyses.30: 句子讨论听莫扎特音乐如何影响大脑活动。提高大脑活动通常与认知功能有关。空白处需要一个形容词修饰function。选项C) cognitive 意为“认知的”，符合文意，表示提高认知功能。
analyses.31: 句子提到连产科的...也用莫扎特音乐帮助新生儿适应。产科通常有病房。空白处需要一个名词。选项O) wards 意为“病房，特定场所”，在此指产科病房或部门，符合文意。
analyses.32: 句子说听古典音乐...降低人的血压。降低血压的程度通常用副词修饰动词reduces。空白处需要一个副词。选项M) significantly 意为“显著地，大量地”，符合文意，表示显著降低血压。
analyses.33: 句子说平静的古典音乐可能帮助你的心脏...从压力中。心脏从压力中需要恢复。空白处需要一个动词原形与help搭配。选项L) recover 意为“恢复”，符合文意，表示帮助心脏从压力中恢复。
analyses.34: 句子的意思是，无论你是否经常听古典音乐，花点时间听你觉得...的音乐不会有坏处。固定搭配 it wouldn't hurt to do sth 意为“做某事没有坏处”。空白处需要一个动词原形。选项E) hurt 意为“伤害”，在此语境下用于固定搭配，符合文意。
analyses.35: 句子说花点时间听你觉得...的音乐。音乐通常被描述为“舒缓的，抚慰的”。空白处需要一个形容词修饰music。选项N) soothing 意为“舒缓的，抚慰的”，符合文意。
analyses.46: 文章第二段列出了影响人们是否干预的几个因素，其中第二点是“the company's culture needs to make them feel safe to speak up”，即公司文化需要让他们觉得站出来是安全的。这意味着不利的工作场所文化（Unfavorable workplace culture）是导致不干预的因素之一，因为在这种文化下，员工可能不敢发声。选项A、C、D在文中未被明确列为直接因素。
analyses.47: 文章第三段解释了“bystander effect”（旁观者效应）和“diffusion of responsibility”（责任扩散）。它说：“Basically the larger the crowd, the more people assume that someone else will take care of it—meaning no one effectively intervenes or acts in a moment of need.”这解释了“责任扩散”的含义：人群越大，人们越认为别人会处理，结果就没有人有效干预。选项D准确地概括了这一含义。
analyses.48: 文章第五段指出，“When a group of employees sees unsafe behavior not being addressed at a leadership level it creates the precedent that this is how these situations should be addressed, thus defining the safety culture for everyone.”意思是当员工看到领导层面不处理不安全行为时，会建立一个先例，认为这就是处理这类情况的方式，从而定义了所有人的安全文化。这意味着其他人看到类似行为时也可能选择不干预。选项A符合这一推论，即没有人会干预。
analyses.49: 文章第六段明确指出，“Fear is the ultimate factor in not intervening. There is a fear of penalty, a fear that they'll have to do more work if they intervene.” 意思是“恐惧是不干预的最终因素”，其中包括“害怕必须做更多工作”。选项D直接指出了这一点。
analyses.50: 第八段指出，管理者不仅要识别和减少工作场所的危险，还要在团队中营造一种安全氛围（safety climate），鼓励团队成员进行干预和公开交流。C项中的“create a safety environment for timely intervention”与原文中的“safety climate”及“encourage intervention”同义转述，因此是确保工作场所安全的关键。
analyses.51: 文章第二段明确指出：“The distinction between these two strands of environmentalism is the cause of a split within the scientific community about nuclear energy”。这两“股”环境主义分别指的是第一段提到的保护野生动植物和自然生态系统，以及应对人为气候变化。科学界在核能问题上的分歧源于对环境主义的不同理解。选项D“坚持对环境主义的不同解释”最符合文意。
analyses.52: 文章第三段描述了纯粹主义者的对立面观点：“The opposing side agrees that renewables are crucial, but says society needs an amount of power available to meet consumers basic demands when the sun isn’t shining and the wind isn't blowing. Nuclear energy, being far cleaner than oil, gas and coal, is a natural option, especially where hydroelectric capacity is limited.” 他们认为可再生能源很重要，但在太阳不照、风不吹时需要其他能源，并提出核能是一个选择。因此，他们提议在必要时选择核能。选项C符合这一观点。
analyses.53: 文章第六段在讨论“achievability of universal 100% renewability”（普遍实现100%可再生能源的可能性）的争议性时，提到了像Burlington这样的城市虽然声称100%可再生，但它们人口少，有时仍依赖化石燃料，且拥有丰富的可再生资源。同时提到能完全依靠可再生能源的国家通常依赖水电能力。这些例子旨在说明，全球完全依赖可再生能源的目标是存在争议的，其可行性受到地理、人口和现有资源等多种因素的限制。选项A最准确地概括了作者通过Burlington例子所想表达的观点。
analyses.54: 文章第七段开头说：“Germany stands as the best case study for a large, industrialized country pushing into green energy.” （德国是大型工业化国家推进绿色能源的最佳案例研究）。尽管后文也提到了德国在推进过程中遇到的问题，但这句话表明作者将德国视为一个在绿色能源方面努力推进的代表性案例。选项B符合这一描述。
analyses.55: 文章第八段解释了德国进展放缓的原因之一：“Lagging grid infrastructure struggles to transport this overabundance of green energy from Germany's north to its industrial south...”。这说明滞后的电网基础设施难以将北部的绿色能源输送到南部的工业区，导致进展受阻。选项A准确地指出了电网基础设施不足是原因之一。选项B描述了过度供应导致的问题，但不是进展停滞的主要原因，而且电厂不会因此暂停运营。选项C只是描述了南部的情况，不是进展停滞的根本原因。选项D提到了不稳定，但文中更强调的是电网无法有效输送产生的能源。

Just as Copernicus realized the Earth is not the center of the universe. Professor Oliver said society urgently needs a Copernican-like revolution to understand people are not detached beings, but rather part of one connected identity. A significant milestone in the cultural evolution of human minds was the acceptance that the Earth is not the center of the universe. The so-called Copernican Revolution, he writes. However, we have one more big myth to dispose of that we exist as independent selves at the center of a subjective universe. You may feel as if you're an independent individual acting autonomously in the world that you have unchanging in yourself that persists throughout your lifetime acting as a central anchor point with the world changing around you. This is the illusion I seek to tackle. We are intimately connected to the world around us. Professor Oliver argues, there are around 37 trillion cells in the body, but most have a lifespan of just a few days or weeks. So the material us is constantly changing. In fact, there is no part of your body that has existed for more than 10 years. Since our bodies are essentially made a new every few weeks. The material in them alone is clearly insufficient. To explain the persistent thread of an identity, Professor Oliver Claims that individualism is actually bad for society, and only by realizing we are part of a bigger entity can we solve pressing environmental and societal problems. Through selfish over consumption, we are destroying the natural world and using non-renewable resources at an accelerating rate. We are at a critical crossroads as a species where we must rapidly reform our mindsets and behavior to act in less selfish ways he said. So let's open our eyes to the hidden connections all around us.

translation.prompt: 中国的传统婚礼习俗历史悠久，从周朝开始就逐渐形成了一套完整的婚礼仪式，有些一直沿用至今。如今的中式婚礼习俗已有很大变化，但婚礼庆典仍然十分隆重。婚礼场地经过精心装饰，以象征喜庆(jubilance)的红色为主色调，摆放着许多祝愿新人幸福的物件。在婚礼上，新人要拜天地(bow to Heaven and Earth)，拜父母和相互对拜，然后设宴招待宾客，并向宾客敬酒致谢。今天，许多年轻人依然钟情于传统的中式婚礼，体验独特而美好的中国式浪漫。
translation.reference: China's traditional wedding customs have a long history. A complete set of wedding ceremonies gradually took shape starting from the Zhou Dynasty, some of which are still followed today. Although modern Chinese wedding customs have undergone significant changes, the wedding celebrations remain very grand. The wedding venue is elaborately decorated, primarily in red symbolizing jubilance, and adorned with many items wishing the newlyweds happiness. During the wedding ceremony, the couple bows to Heaven and Earth, bows to their parents, and bows to each other. Afterwards, a banquet is held to entertain the guests, and the couple toasts the guests to express their gratitude. Today, many young people are still fond of traditional Chinese weddings, experiencing the unique and beautiful Chinese-style romance.

writing.sample: There is a growing awareness of the importance of digital literacy and skills in today's world. In the modern era, technology permeates almost every aspect of our lives, from communication and education to employment and commerce. Possessing the ability to effectively navigate, evaluate, and create digital content is no longer a luxury but a necessity. For students, digital literacy is crucial for online learning, research, and collaborating on projects. In the workplace, proficiency with various software, online tools, and data management is expected in most professions. Beyond academics and careers, digital skills empower individuals to access information, engage in civic life, and connect with others safely and responsibly. Without these competencies, people risk being left behind, facing challenges in accessing opportunities and participating fully in society. Therefore, investing time and effort in developing strong digital literacy is essential for personal and professional success in the 21st century.

analyses.27: 句子描述了Natasha想要摆脱她父母造成的移民处境，她为此“strives”（努力，奋斗）。

analyses.32: 句子说她通过科学视角对宇宙的痴迷是会传染的，“and I adore Daniel seeing that too”（我也喜欢看到Daniel也感受到这一点），虽然表达有点不自然，但根据答案选择，adore是唯一合适的词。
analyses.33: Daniel的甜言蜜语或表达方式甚至能“cracks”（击破，打破）Natasha坚硬的外壳。
analyses.34: 作者描述自己读这本书时，“I got lost in The Sun Is Also a Star”（我沉浸在《太阳也是一颗星星》这本书里），表示读得非常投入。
analyses.35: 这里描述的是两个人之间那种特别的感觉，那种“chemistry”（化学反应，默契），让他们彼此吸引和互动。
analyses.46: 文章第一段指出，“young Americans today are struggling to earn more than their parents did at the same age, and upward mobility in the US actually compares unfavourably to that of other industrialised nations.”（当今的年轻美国人难以赚得比他们父母在同龄时更多，并且美国的向上流动性与其他工业化国家相比实际上并不乐观）。这直接表明他们发现实现向上流动很困难，对应B选项。
analyses.47: 文章描述了Kim团队进行的实验，结果显示“those who'd watched a rags-to-riches clip did indeed have a significantly greater belief in the American Dream.”（观看白手起家故事片段的参与者确实对美国梦有显著更强的信念）。这表明真人秀节目有助于增强人们对美国梦的信念，对应C选项。
analyses.48: 文章第三段提到，“while these programmes [reality shows] are regularly among the most-watched shows, news broadcasts…get a much smaller proportion of the viewership”（尽管这些节目[真人秀]是收视率最高的节目之一，新闻广播…获得的收视比例要小得多）。这表明新闻广播吸引的观众比真人秀少得多，对应A选项。
analyses.49: 文章提到实验结果显示，观看白手起家故事片段对信念的影响在共和党人中显著，但在民主党人中不显著，“suggesting that the kind of messages implicit in these TV shows may play into people's existing socioeconomic beliefs.”（这表明这些电视节目中隐含的信息可能会影响人们现有的社会经济信念）。这暗示共和党人现有的信念更倾向于相信美国梦（或更容易被这类信息强化），从而推断他们普遍坚信美国梦，对应A选项。文章并未提及他们是否努力攀爬社会经济阶梯（B）、他们党派认同感强弱（C）或他们是否更倾向于观看这类节目（D）。
analyses.50: 文章最后一段指出，“if people mistakenly believe that hard work is all that is needed... they may be less supportive of policies that could actually combat inequality.”（如果人们错误地认为只需要努力工作…他们可能不太支持那些能真正解决不平等的政策）。相信向上流动性主要取决于个人努力的人，不太可能支持旨在减少不平等的政策，对应D选项。
analyses.51: 文章第二段提到失业会引发“an identity crisis much greater than the loss of the job itself.”（比失去工作本身更大的身份危机），并引用了“Without my job I don't know who I am,”（没有工作我不知道我是谁）这句话。这表明失业让人对自己是谁感到困惑，对应C选项。A选项提到的临床心理学家是作者的职业，不是说失业一定会去看心理医生。B选项不对，失业是失去一个角色，可能需要去扮演其他角色，但文中强调的是身份困惑。D选项没有直接提及。
analyses.52: 文章第三段开头说，“One of the things I have come to understand, however, is that our identity is much more complex than we recognise at first glance.”（然而，我开始理解的一件事是，我们的身份比乍一看要复杂得多）。这直接对应D选项。
analyses.53: 文章第三段提到，“Furthermore, our identities at work are not static. They change over time.”（此外，我们在工作中的身份并非一成不变。它们会随着时间而改变）。这直接对应B选项。
analyses.54: 文章第三段结尾处提到，“Whilst we like to eliminate uncertainty in our lives at some level we have to manage uncertainty, especially in today's volatile and ever-shifting job market.”（虽然我们喜欢消除生活中的不确定性，但在某种程度上我们必须管理不确定性，尤其是在当今动荡和不断变化的就业市场中）。这直接对应D选项。
analyses.55: 文章第四段提到，“consider personal change… you can create a new experience of your identity by changing the beliefs you hold about yourself in order to expand your career options.”（考虑个人改变…通过改变你对自己持有的信念来创造一种新的身份体验，从而拓展你的职业选择）。改变对自己持有的信念就是改变对自己看法的过程，对应A选项。

translation.prompt: 中国盛产竹子，是最早开发利用竹资源的国家。竹子在中国分布广泛，品种丰富。竹子实用性强，用于生产和生活的许多方面，如筷子、桌椅的制作和桥梁、房屋的建造。中国人爱竹，自古以来就有无数文人以竹为主题，创作了绚丽多彩的文学和绘画作品。竹子主干(stem)笔直，象征正直的品格。竹子具有强大的生命力和适应能力，无论环境多么恶劣，都能够顽强生存，因而寓意坚韧不拔的精神。几千年来，竹子一直被视为中华民族品格的象征。

writing.sample: Nowadays more and more college students have come to realize social practice and academic learning are equally important.  While academic knowledge forms the foundation, practical experience gained through social activities, internships, and volunteer work is invaluable. Theoretical understanding from lectures is crucial, but applying this knowledge in real-world scenarios enhances comprehension and develops essential skills like problem-solving, communication, and teamwork. For example, participating in a marketing internship helps students understand how classroom theories translate into actual campaigns and consumer behavior.  Similarly, volunteering exposes students to diverse social issues and builds empathy. These experiences complement academic learning, preparing students more comprehensively for future careers and active citizenship.  A balanced approach integrating both elements is key to holistic personal and professional development during the university years.
writing.prompt: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “Nowadays more and more college students have come to realize social practice and academic learning are equally important.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.

analyses.34: 光线弹回与它“源于”的方向相反的方向。'originates'意为“起源，来自于”，符合语境。

analyses.46: 文章第一段提到：“Sarcasm and jazz have something surprisingly in common: You know them when you hear them.” 指出它们都能通过听来识别，这与选项A吻合。
analyses.47: 文章第四段提到：“many people who receive sarcastic comments feel put down and often think the sarcastic person is rude, or contemptible.” 'feel put down' 意为感到被贬低，这与选项B中的 'belittled and disrespected' 吻合。
analyses.48: 文章第五段提到：“What’s more...when a person consistently acts sarcastically it may only serve to heighten their underlying hostility and insecurity.” 这与选项B吻合。
analyses.49: 文章第六段提到：“when a person stops voicing negative comments, especially sarcastic ones, they may soon start to feel happier and more self-confident. Also. other people in their life benefit even more because they no longer have to hear the emotionally hurtful language of sarcasm.” 这表明停止挖苦不仅对说话者自己有益（感觉更快乐、更自信），对他们身边的人也更有益（不再听到伤人的话），因此选项C最准确。
analyses.50: 文章最后一段详细对比了机智（wit）和挖苦（sarcasm）。文中提到“sarcasm is often hostility disguised as humor. It can be intended to hurt... Witty statements... the intent is to untangle and clarify the issue... Sarcastic statements are expressed in a cutting manner; witty remarks are delivered with undisguised and harmless humor.” 这里的对比核心在于其“意图”（intent）。挖苦的意图通常是伤害，而机智的意图是澄清问题或带来无害的幽默。因此，主要的区别在于意图。
analyses.51: 文章第二段提到：“For instance, infants will struggle to learn the category “dog” if they are only exposed to Chihuahuas, instead of many different kinds of dogs.” 'struggle to' 意为“费力做某事，遇到困难”，所以他们会遇到一些困难，与选项A吻合。
analyses.52: 文章第五段Raviv说：“These four kinds of variability have never been directly compared — which means that we currently don’t know which is most effective for learning,” 这表明目前还不清楚哪一种最有利于学习，与选项D吻合。
analyses.53: 文章倒数第三段提到的第三个解释是：“A third reason has to do with the way memory works: when training is variable, learners are forced to actively reconstruct their memories.” 这与选项B吻合。
analyses.54: 文章倒数第二段引用Raviv的话说：“For example, face recognition is affected by whether people grew up in a Small community or in a larger community. Exposure to fewer faces during childhood is associated with diminished face memory.” 这直接说明了人们成长社区的大小影响他们的面部识别能力，与选项D吻合。选项A、B、C与原文意思不完全一致或未提及。
analyses.55: 文章最后一段引用Raviv的话说：““We hope this work will spark peoples curiosity and generate more work on the topic.” 这直接表达了他们希望激发人们对变异性的好奇心并推动更多相关研究，与选项C吻合。

translation.prompt: 扇子自古以来就深受中国人喜爱，但现在已不只是消暑纳凉的工具，而更多地作为艺术品供人欣赏。许多扇子造型优美、做工精良，并绘有山水、花鸟、人物等精美图案，具有很高的艺术价值。中国许多著名画家和书法家喜欢在扇子上作诗绘画，展示其艺术品味。扇子常作为礼物赠予他人，表达美好的祝福和真挚的情感。如今, 扇子的实用功能已大为减弱，但作为一种文化符号和艺术形式，扇子仍然在中国传统文化中扮演着重要角色。
translation.reference: Fans have been deeply loved by Chinese people since ancient times. However, nowadays they are no longer merely tools for keeping cool in summer, but are more often appreciated as works of art. Many fans have elegant shapes and exquisite craftsmanship, and are painted with beautiful patterns such as landscapes, flowers and birds, and figures, possessing high artistic value. Many famous Chinese painters and calligraphers enjoy composing poems and painting on fans, showcasing their artistic taste. Fans are often given as gifts to others to express good wishes and sincere emotions. Although the practical function of fans has greatly diminished today, as a cultural symbol and art form, fans still play an important role in traditional Chinese culture.

writing.sample: Nowadays cultivating independent learning ability is becoming increasingly crucial for personal development. In our fast-evolving society, the ability to learn independently is no longer a luxury but a necessity. Formal education provides a foundation, but true growth requires individuals to take charge of their own learning journey. This involves proactively seeking out knowledge, critically evaluating information from various sources, and developing problem-solving skills independently. Unlike traditional rote learning, independent learning fosters deeper understanding and encourages critical thinking. For example, conducting personal research projects or exploring new subjects out of curiosity helps students develop crucial analytical skills and self-discipline. This self-reliance not only enhances academic performance but also builds resilience and adaptability, preparing individuals to effectively face future challenges and pursue lifelong growth in any field.

analyses.2:
原文：Thank you. I appreciate the recognition. (00:01:26,120 --> 00:01:27,900)
翻译：谢谢。我很感谢您的认可。
解释：在男子称赞了女子勤奋、准时、勤劳，并具有很强的分析能力和对细节的关注之后，女子回答说“I appreciate the recognition”（我感谢您的认可）。这里的recognition指的是对她优点和良好表现的认可。选项D“The recognition of her merits”（对她优点的认可）与此直接对应。其他选项在对话中并未提及是她所感谢的。
analyses.3:
原文：This mostly centers around one behavioral aspect. Your ability to work with others. (00:01:53,120 --> 00:02:05,400) Yes. As you already know, over the last several months there have been some complaints raised about your communication style. (00:02:06,100 --> 00:02:14,920)
翻译：这主要围绕一个行为方面。你与他人合作的能力。是的。正如你已经知道的，在过去的几个月里，有人对你的沟通方式提出了一些抱怨。
解释：男子明确指出抱怨主要集中在女子的“ability to work with others”（与他人合作的能力）和“communication style”（沟通方式）。选项B“Her inability to interact with colleagues properly”（她与同事互动不当的能力）是对这一点的概括。选项A“Her inadequate language proficiency”（她语言能力不足）未提及。选项C“Her inappropriate behavior at company meetings”（她在公司会议上的不当行为）是沟通方式的一种可能体现，但范围过窄。选项D“Her simplistic approach to dealing with others”（她处理人际关系的简单方式）可能是其沟通方式带来的感知，但原文更直接指向互动和沟通能力问题。
analyses.4:
原文：Simply put, I don't like to write long emails because, frankly, I think they're a waste of time. Consiceness is efficiency. I feel that writing long emails hurts that same productivity you praised me for just a minute ago. (00:02:24,580 --> 00:02:39,720)
翻译：简单地说，我不喜欢写冗长的电子邮件，坦率地说，我认为这浪费时间。简洁就是效率。我觉得写长邮件会损害您刚才夸奖我的那种效率。
解释：女子明确表示不喜欢写长邮件是因为她认为长邮件是“a waste of time”（浪费时间），并认为“Consiceness is efficiency”（简洁就是效率），写长邮件会影响“productivity”（效率）。这表明她是为了节省时间和提高效率。选项C“To save time”（为了节省时间）与她的理由“waste of time”和“efficiency”一致。选项A、B、D都不是她不写长邮件的主要原因。
analyses.5:
原文：I've always wanted to be a doctor. I come from a small town where health care was never the best, and I think that had a profound effect on me. As a child, I remember thinking how great it would be to serve the community and cure people. (00:04:14,859 --> 00:04:29,180)
翻译：我一直想成为一名医生。我来自一个医疗保健从来不是最好的小镇，我认为这对我产生了深远的影响。小时候，我记得想过为社区服务、治愈人们会有多好。
解释：女子说她“一直想成为一名医生”，并且“小时候”就想“serve the community and cure people”（为社区服务、治愈人们）。选项A“Provide medical service to the community”（为社区提供医疗服务）直接捕捉了她儿时的愿望。选项B“Make healthcare in her hometown the best”（使家乡的医疗保健达到最佳）是背景，不是她个人的梦想。选项C“Obtain a doctoral degree in internal medicine”（获得内科博士学位）是未来的专业方向，不是儿时的梦想。选项D“Have a profound impact on people around her”（对周围的人产生深远影响）是一个更广泛的愿望，而原文具体指出了是服务社区和治愈人。
analyses.6:
原文：I would certainly say my parents have been a key factor. They always pushed me to study hard, and I certainly wouldn't be here without their support. (00:04:41,200 --> 00:04:45,500)
翻译：我当然会说我的父母是一个关键因素。他们总是督促我努力学习，没有他们的支持，我肯定不会在这里。
解释：女子明确提到父母是关键因素，并且“They always pushed me to study hard”（他们总是督促我努力学习）。选项A“They have constantly urged her to study hard”（他们一直督促她努力学习）与此一致。选项B和C可能隐含在“support”中，但原文最明确提及的是“pushed me to study hard”。选项D没有证据支持。
analyses.7:
原文：Why internal medicine? I know it's no picnic, but I think that the most intriguing, because it covers so much, entice together, so many other specialties. (00:05:11,600 --> 00:05:21,420)
翻译：为什么选择内科？我知道这并不轻松，但我认为它是最吸引人的，因为它涵盖了很多东西，将如此多其他专业联系在一起。
解释：女子解释选择内科的原因是它“covers so much”（涵盖如此多），并且将“so many other specialties”（如此多其他专业）“entice together”（联系在一起）。选项B“It connects many other specialties with its broad coverage”（它通过广泛的涵盖连接了许多其他专业）是对这一理由的准确总结。其他选项在对话中均未提及。
analyses.8:
原文：I'm looking at your school grades now, and I'll be honest. It's a bit of a mixed bag. You do get top grades here and there, but you are not very shall we say, consistent? (00:05:46,320 --> 00:05:58,360)
翻译：我现在正在看你的学校成绩，说实话，有点参差不齐。你这里那里都能拿到高分，但你并不是很……怎么说呢，稳定一致？
解释：男子描述女子的学校成绩是“a bit of a mixed bag”（有点参差不齐），并且说她“are not very... consistent?”（不是非常……稳定一致？）。选项C“Inconsistent”（不稳定的，不一致的）与原文描述直接对应。选项A“Problematic”（有问题的）过于负面，尽管成绩不稳定可能带来问题，但这并非直接描述。选项B“Competitive”（有竞争力的）和D“Trustworthy”（值得信赖的）均与原文描述不符。
analyses.9:
原文：More often than not, you then have to choose photos that include a street sign, as this apparently provides solid evidence to your computer that you are, in fact, a human being. (00:08:22,360 --> 00:08:33,900)
翻译：通常情况下，你必须选择包含街道标志的照片，因为这显然能向你的电脑提供确凿的证据，证明你实际上是一个人类。
解释：文章明确解释选择包含街道标志的照片是为了向计算机证明用户是人类（“provides solid evidence to your computer that you are, in fact, a human being”）。这是一种验证方式，通常用来区分人类用户和自动化程序（机器人）。选项D“To convince our computer that we are human”（为了让我们的电脑相信我们是人类）与此一致。选项A、B、C均与原文解释不符。
analyses.10:
原文：Now a new peer-reviewed study by researchers at Alto University in Finland is attempting to figure out why we forget our passwords in order to help put an end to this frustrating phenomenon. (00:08:41,320 --> 00:08:54,440)
翻译：现在，芬兰阿尔托大学研究人员的一项新的经过同行评审的研究正试图找出我们忘记密码的原因，以帮助结束这种令人沮丧的现象。
解释：研究的目的是“attempting to figure out why we forget our passwords”（试图找出我们忘记密码的原因），最终目标是“in order to help put an end to this frustrating phenomenon”（为了帮助结束这种令人沮丧的现象）。这个“现象”指的是忘记密码。因此，研究旨在帮助人们不再忘记密码，即帮助人们记住密码。选项B“Help people remember their passwords”（帮助人们记住他们的密码）最贴合这一目标。选项A“Put an end to the hacking phenomenon”（结束黑客现象）扩大了研究范围。选项C“Reduce the intricacy of the password itself”（降低密码本身的复杂性）是研究的发现之一（复杂性与记忆无关），但不是研究的目的。选项D“Explain the need for different email accounts”（解释使用不同电子邮件账户的必要性）未提及。
analyses.11:
原文：The researchers advise websites to include more of an incentive for users to log in more often in order to help them remember their secret codes. (00:09:24,580 --> 00:09:34,360)
翻译：研究人员建议网站提供更多激励，鼓励用户更频繁地登录，以帮助他们记住密码。
解释：文章结尾明确指出研究人员建议网站“to include more of an incentive for users to log in more often”（提供更多激励，鼓励用户更频繁地登录）。选项D“Take steps to encourage users to log in more often”（采取措施鼓励用户更频繁地登录）与这一建议一致。其他选项均未提及。
analyses.12:
原文：4 years ago, Jenny Wainer was in a fitness slump. She wanted to improve her physical and mental health. (00:10:42,800 --> 00:10:50,360)
翻译：四年前，珍妮·韦纳陷入了健身低谷。她想改善她的身心健康。
解释：文章开头就指出珍妮·韦纳在四年前“was in a fitness slump”（陷入了健身低谷）。选项C“Her fitness fell into a slump”（她的健康状况陷入低谷）直接引用了原文。其他选项均未提及。
analyses.13:
原文：To use the app, you first input your profile about your previous training experiences and preferences, as well as your desired goals. A virtual coach then uses that information to suggest a personalized training regime. (00:11:24,319 --> 00:11:37,100)
翻译：要使用该应用程序，你首先输入你的个人信息，包括你之前的训练经验和偏好，以及你想要达到的目标。然后，一个虚拟教练会利用这些信息建议一个个性化的训练方案。
解释：文章描述了应用程序的工作方式：用户输入信息后，“A virtual coach then uses that information to suggest a personalized training regime”（虚拟教练会利用这些信息建议一个个性化的训练方案）。选项B“Design personalised training programmes”（设计个性化训练计划）是对“suggest a personalized training regime”的同义转述。其他选项未提及是该应用程序的功能。
analyses.14:
原文：Now, Miss Wainer finds the workouts exciting. This is because no two are ever the same. (00:11:52,740 --> 00:11:58,760)
翻译：现在，韦纳女士觉得锻炼很令人兴奋。这是因为没有两次锻炼是完全一样的。
解释：文章解释了珍妮·韦纳现在觉得锻炼令人兴奋的原因是“no two are ever the same”（没有两次是完全一样的）。选项A“They are never repeated”（它们从不重复）与此意思相符。其他选项未提及。
analyses.15:
原文：However, some experts think that apps cannot replace human personal trainers... (00:12:13,940 --> 00:12:21,000)
翻译：然而，一些专家认为应用程序不能取代人类私人教练……
解释：文章引述了一些专家的观点，第一句就明确指出“apps cannot replace human personal trainers”（应用程序不能取代人类私人教练）。选项A“They will not be able to take the place of human personal trainers”（它们无法取代人类私人教练）与此一致。专家后面列举了应用程序的局限性（不能理解人类行为、不能感知微妙之处等），这些都是为了支持“不能取代人类教练”这一观点。选项B是专家的具体理由之一，但A是更全面的观点。选项C和D与专家观点相悖，专家认为应用程序的数学方法可以安排更精细的计划并带来最佳结果，但认为它们缺乏人类的理解和感知能力。
analyses.16:
原文：Also societies are held together by 7 universal moral rules... The huge study of 60 different cultures around the world found that all communities operate under seven basic moral codes. (00:14:43,220 --> 00:15:19,720) Those universal rules are... Everyone everywhere shares a common moral code... These seven moral rules appear to be universal across cultures... (00:15:27,960 --> 00:16:11,200)
翻译：此外，社会由七个普遍的道德规则维系在一起……这项对世界各地60种不同文化的巨大研究发现，所有社群都遵循七个基本的道德准则。这些普遍规则是……世界各地的每个人都共享一套共同的道德准则……这七个道德规则似乎在各种文化中都是普遍存在的……
解释：文章多次强调牛津大学研究的结论是社会由“7 universal moral rules”或“seven basic moral codes”维系，并且这些规则是“universal across cultures”。选项C“All societies are kept together by seven basic moral rules”（所有社会都由七个基本的道德规则维系）最准确地概括了这一核心结论。选项A“All societies are built upon the cornerstones of basic values”（所有社会都建立在基本价值观的基石之上）过于笼统。选项B“Everyone everywhere demonstrates seven character traits”（世界各地的每个人都表现出七种性格特征）是相关的，但研究的重点是道德规则，不是性格特征。选项D“Everyone everywhere shares a universal moral standard”（世界各地的每个人都共享一个普遍的道德标准）接近，但原文具体指出了是“seven basic moral rules/codes”，C更精确。
analyses.17:
原文：The study published in current anthropology is... aimed to find out whether different societies had different versions of morality. (00:16:29,660 --> 00:16:44,420)
翻译：发表在《当代人类学》上的这项研究……旨在找出不同的社会是否拥有不同版本的道德观。
解释：文章明确说明这项研究的“aimed to find out whether different societies had different versions of morality”（旨在找出不同的社会是否拥有不同版本的道德观）。选项B“Find out whether different societies had different versions of morality”（找出不同的社会是否有不同版本的道德观）与原文完全一致。其他选项提及的内容（例如，deferring to authority, group loyalty等）是研究过程中讨论的具体道德规则或现象，而不是研究的主要目的。
analyses.18:
原文：Co-author Professor Harvey Whitehouse said social scientists should now set about testing the theory in the field rather than relying on old data... In future, social scientists are serious about testing theories and morality, they will need to gather new data more systematically out in the field. (00:17:24,740 --> 00:17:57,520)
翻译：合著者哈维·怀特豪斯教授表示，社会科学家现在应该着手在实地检验理论，而不是依赖旧数据……将来，社会科学家如果认真对待道德理论的检验，就需要更系统地在实地收集新数据。
解释：哈维·怀特豪斯教授认为社会科学家应该“set about testing the theory in the field rather than relying on old data”（着手在实地检验理论而不是依赖旧数据），并且强调需要“to gather new data more systematically out in the field”（更系统地在实地收集新数据）。选项D“Carry out systematic field studies to gather new data”（进行系统的实地研究以收集新数据）是对他观点的概括。选项A是提及了现有数据的来源，但不是他建议未来要做的事。选项B未提及。选项C与他的观点（不应依赖旧数据）相反。
analyses.19:
原文：For all the talk of the tongue, our eyes really might be the most important part of the eating experience. (00:19:37,440 --> 00:19:43,480)
翻译：尽管我们常谈论舌头，但我们的眼睛可能才是饮食体验中最重要的部分。
解释：演讲者明确说“our eyes really might be the most important part of the eating experience”（我们的眼睛可能才是饮食体验中最重要的部分）。选项A“They might be the most important part of our eating experience”（它们可能是我们饮食体验中最重要的部分）与原文一致。其他选项未在原文中提及。
analyses.20:
原文：...and the result is that color actually changes how we taste food. (00:19:55,679 --> 00:19:58,240)
翻译：……结果是颜色实际上改变了我们品尝食物的方式。
解释：演讲者在提到大脑处理视觉和味觉功能的比例后，直接给出了结论“color actually changes how we taste food”（颜色实际上改变了我们品尝食物的方式）。选项D“It changes the way people taste food”（它改变了人们品尝食物的方式）与此一致。选项A是前面提到的事实，不是颜色本身的作用。选项B与文章主要论点相反。选项C未提及颜色能“invariably determines how food sells”（总是决定食物的销售方式）。
analyses.21:
原文：The key to these questions is the effect of color on expectation. The brain makes predictions using color. (00:20:56,640 --> 00:21:03,680)
翻译：这些问题的关键在于颜色对预期的影响。大脑利用颜色进行预测。
解释：演讲者在解释为什么颜色会影响味觉时指出，关键在于颜色对“expectation”（预期）的影响，并明确说“The brain makes predictions using color”（大脑利用颜色进行预测）。选项B“Make predictions”（进行预测）与原文一致。其他选项A、C、D是颜色影响味觉可能产生的效果，但不是大脑利用颜色的具体功能（即进行预测）。
analyses.22:
原文：Searching for meaning is something many of us experience throughout our lives. (00:22:51,840 --> 00:22:54,920)
翻译：寻找意义是我们许多人一生中都会经历的事情。
解释：演讲者开头第一句就明确指出“Searching for meaning is something many of us experience throughout our lives”（寻找意义是我们许多人一生中都会经历的事情）。选项C“Meaning”（意义）与原文一致。其他选项未被这样概括为许多人一生中都在寻找的东西。
analyses.23:
原文：Rear, Casapano, from the University of Toronto, and colleagues find meaning is a far weaker predictor of happiness for rich people than poorer people, suggesting economic resources can impact how we experience meaning. (00:23:10,400 --> 00:23:26,700)
翻译：多伦多大学的利亚·卡萨帕诺和同事发现，意义对于富人来说是幸福的远较弱的预测因子，相比于穷人，这表明经济资源可以影响我们如何体验意义。
解释：研究者利亚·卡萨帕诺及其同事发现，“economic resources can impact how we experience meaning”（经济资源可以影响我们如何体验意义）。选项C“They can affect people’s experience of meaning”（它们可以影响人们对意义的体验）与此一致。选项A未提及。选项B未明确说明。选项D与原文（经济资源影响意义与幸福的关系，而非直接确保幸福）不符。
analyses.24:
原文：The second study looked at World Wide Data. (00:24:33,960 --> 00:24:37,660) Happiness was measured using the same questions as in the first study, while meaning was measured using the single question... Again, the strength of the relationship between meaning and happiness depends on participants' income. Meaning had a greater influence on happiness for those on lower incomes compared to those in higher brackets. (00:24:38,200 --> 00:25:06,660)
翻译：第二项研究调查了全球数据。幸福感使用与第一项研究相同的问题来衡量，而意义则使用一个单一的问题来衡量……同样，意义与幸福之间关系的强度取决于参与者的收入。与收入较高的人相比，意义对低收入者的幸福感影响更大。
解释：文章明确指出“The second study looked at World Wide Data”（第二项研究调查了全球数据），这包含了来自“multiple countries”（多个国家）的数据。选项D“It examined data collected from multiple countries”（它检查了从多个国家收集的数据）与此一致。选项A错误，幸福感问题与第一项研究相同。选项B是第三项研究的内容。选项C是第一项研究的内容。
analyses.25:
原文：This might be the case because richer individuals have more access to other sources of happiness, Many of which will be external, like lack of stress or community, thus a focus on an internal sense of satisfaction, purpose or meaning is less important. (00:25:54,200 --> 00:26:14,100)
翻译：这可能是因为富裕的人更容易获得其他幸福来源，其中许多是外部的，比如没有压力或社区，因此，关注内在的满足感、目标或意义就不那么重要了。
解释：文章解释了为什么资源更多的人意义与幸福的关系较弱，是因为他们“have more access to other sources of happiness, Many of which will be external”（更容易获得其他幸福来源，其中许多是外部的）。选项A“They might have more access to external sources of happiness”（他们可能有更多获得外部幸福来源的机会）与此直接对应。选项B与原文“thus a focus on an internal sense of satisfaction, purpose or meaning is less important”相反。选项C和D未在原文中提及。
analyses.26: 根据上下文，一些人不再认为“节俭”（thrifty）是一种美德。选项O) thrifty 符合语境。
analyses.27: 与前文提到的“prefer simplicity”（喜欢简朴）和后文的“accumulate”（积累）形成对比，表示有人花钱“挥霍”（extravagantly）。选项B) extravagantly 符合。
analyses.28: 作者说自己出生在农村，简单的乡村生活很少失去对他的“吸引力”（appeal）。选项A) appeal 符合。
analyses.29: 随着作者社会地位的变化，他有机会与新富阶层“交往、融合”（mingle）。选项J) mingle 符合。
analyses.30: 实际上，整个世界都在“疯狂、盛行”（rage）借贷消费。选项L) rage 符合。
analyses.31: 美国是最富有的国家，但“讽刺”（irony）的是他们却向我们借钱。选项D) irony 符合。

analyses.47: 作者的研究表明，人类进化到在“安全的背景下体验负面情绪”的情境中找到快乐。捉迷藏被用作一个“模拟”的例子。第十段明确指出，“许多人觉得恐怖片令人愉悦，因为它让我们玩转负面情绪并发展应对策略。” 选项B“他们发现经历模拟的恐怖体验能带来快乐”最符合这一解释，特别强调了“模拟”和“体验”的过程，而非现实生活中的克服或仅仅是小时候的游戏经验或逃离危险本身带来的快乐。

analyses.50: 文章最后一段提到：“如果你毫发无损地看完这部电影，你可能会体验到强烈的掌控感（a strong sense of mastery），一种能够挺过可怕经历的感觉。” 选项D“一种强烈的掌控感”最符合“a strong sense of mastery”。
analyses.51: 文章第一段明确指出：“但在数字领域，社交媒体决定了什么是美的标准。”（But in the digital arena, social media determines what is considered beautiful.）选项D“它是由社交媒体定义的”直接呼应了这一点。
analyses.52: 文章第二段描述了现实世界的斗争：“在现实世界中，这场斗争是反对施加在女性身上要求她们符合不现实的美丽理想的潜在压力。”（the struggle goes against the underlying pressure exerted on women to conform to an unrealistic beauty ideal.）选项C“一场斗争正在进行，旨在消除要求女性符合荒谬美丽理想的压力”最准确地概括了这一内容。

I've always wanted to be a doctor. I come from a small town where health care was never the best, and I think that had a profound effect on me. What does the brain use colour to do? Recording 3. Searching for meaning is something many of us experience throughout our lives. For some, this meaning is religious. Some, political and some interpersonal. And having a sense of meaning can bring us happiness. A new study looks at the relationship between meaning and happiness in the context of financial resources. Rear, Casapano, from the University of Toronto, and colleagues find meaning is a far weaker predictor of happiness for rich people than poorer people, suggesting economic resources can impact how we experience meaning. The team analyzed data from over 500,000 people across 123 countries. The first study used data from a daily poll of US residents collected between 2013 and 2015. Well-being was tracked using measures of positive affect. Whether during the day before they were surveyed, participants has smiled or laughed a lot, or experienced a lot of happiness. Meaning was measured through a daily purpose index, which explored the extent to which participants felt that they like what they do every day and are motivated to achieve their goals. Finally, income levels were assessed. The results showed that the correlation between meaning and happiness was strongest among those in lower income brackets. But as income levels increased, the correlation became weaker. The second study looked at world-wide data. Happiness was measured using the same questions as in the first study. While meaning was measured using the single question. Do you feel your life has an important purpose or meaning? Again, the strength of the relationship between meaning and happiness depends on participants' income. Meaning had a greater influence on happiness for those on income compared to those in higher brackets. In the final study, French participants indicated the extent to which they felt they led a purposeful and meaningful life, and how much they considered themselves a happy person. Finally, rather than using specific income brackets, they placed themselves on a social ladder, representing where they stand in society with regard to wealth, education and career. The results from this study jupelicated those of the first two. So, overall, meaning and happiness had a stronger relationship in those with fewer resources than those with more. This might be the case because richer individuals have more access to other sources of happiness, many of which will be external, like lack of stress or community. Thus, a focus on an internal sense of satisfaction, purpose or meaning is less important.

translation.prompt: 北斗(Beidou)卫星导航系统的成功研制是中国自改革开放以来取得的一项重大科技成就。研发人员经过不懈努力,攻克了一系列技术难题,北斗系统最终实现了全球覆盖和高精度定位,使中国成为世界上少数几个独立拥有全球卫星导航系统的国家之一。北斗系统已广泛应用于交通运输、灾害救援、天气预报、公共安全等诸多领域。北斗系统现在已经在国际上得到广泛认可,开始为越来越多的国家和地区提供优质服务。
translation.reference: The successful development of the Beidou Satellite Navigation System (Beidou) is a major scientific and technological achievement China has made since the reform and opening up. Through unremitting efforts, R&D personnel overcame a series of technical challenges, and the Beidou system finally achieved global coverage and high-precision positioning, making China one of the few countries in the world that independently possess a global satellite navigation system. The Beidou system has been widely applied in many fields, including transportation, disaster relief, weather forecasting, and public security. The Beidou system has now gained wide international recognition and has begun to provide high-quality services to more and more countries and regions.

writing.sample: To increase the likelihood of success, one should set realistic goals and work persistently towards them.  Unrealistic aspirations often lead to frustration and discouragement when immediate results are not achieved.  A realistic goal, conversely, is attainable, providing a clear path and measurable steps that keep one motivated. It is something one can reasonably aim for given their current abilities and circumstances.  However, merely having a goal is insufficient.  Persistence is equally, if not more, crucial.  The path to success is rarely smooth; it is often filled with obstacles, setbacks, and moments of doubt.  It is the unwavering commitment to continue despite difficulties, learning from failures, and consistently putting in the necessary effort that ultimately leads to achievement.  For example, learning a new language requires consistent daily practice, not just a wish to be fluent.  Combining achievable targets with diligent, sustained effort significantly elevates the probability of turning aspirations into accomplishments.

analyses.9: 原文音频 00:07:50,380 --> 00:08:02,640 文章提到新研究的结果：“As a new study suggests, the more parents engaged in conversation with preschoolers during TV time, the more likely those children were to have higher curiosity levels when they reached kindergarten.”（一项新研究表明，父母在孩子看电视时与学龄前儿童进行对话越多，这些孩子在入园时拥有更高好奇心水平的可能性就越大。）选项A“Parents’ talking with them during TV time raises their curiosity levels.”（父母在孩子看电视时与他们交谈能提高他们的好奇心水平）是这项新研究的主要发现。
analyses.10: 原文音频 00:08:41,919 --> 00:08:48,240 文章指出：“The study specifically focused on curiosity levels, which are associated with enhanced learning and higher academic achievement in reading and math at kindergarten, and behavioral developmental benefits, especially for children from families with lower socio-economic status.”（这项研究特别关注好奇心水平，好奇心与幼儿园阶段的增强学习、更高的阅读和数学学术成就以及行为发展益处相关，特别是对于社会经济地位较低家庭的孩子。）研究的具体焦点是“curiosity levels”（好奇心水平）。选项B“Kids’ curiosity levels.”（孩子的好奇心水平）符合原文。
analyses.11: 原文音频 00:09:29,700 --> 00:09:42,360 文章提到：“Excessive media exposure, including television, can displace exploratory activities such as play and parent-child interactions, which believe to be key to cultivating curiosity in kids.”（过度接触媒体，包括电视，会取代探索性活动，如玩耍和亲子互动，这些被认为是培养孩子好奇心的关键。）“displace”意为取代或挤占。因此，过度接触媒体会挤占孩子们进行探索性活动的时间。选项B“It can cut into kids’ time on exploratory activities.”（它会挤占孩子们进行探索性活动的时间）符合原文含义。
analyses.12: 原文音频 00:11:05,780 --> 00:11:21,020 文章描述了天生获取驱动力的阴暗面：“The dark side of this drive to acquire is being mindlessly driven to possess more and more things and to socially compare our stuff with all the stuff other people have in their lives.”（这种获取驱动力的阴暗面是盲目地被驱使着拥有越来越多的东西，并与生活中其他人拥有的东西进行社会比较。）选项D“Being mindlessly driven to possess more and more material things.”（盲目地被驱使着拥有越来越多的物质东西）与原文中的“being mindlessly driven to possess more and more things”相符。
analyses.13: 原文音频 00:12:04,520 --> 00:12:09,580 文章警告说：“If you're not consciously, mindfully and intentionally harnessing this inborn drive to acquire. You might be mindlessly pursuing all the wrong things.”（如果你不自觉、不留心、不用心地驾驭这种天生的获取驱动力，你可能就会盲目地追求所有错误的东西。）选项C“We might end up pursuing all the wrong things.”（我们可能最终会追求所有错误的东西）直接反映了这一警告。
analyses.14: 原文音频 00:12:18,960 --> 00:12:25,400 文章谈到有意的志向目标时说：“While your intentional aspirational goals will include the pursuit of acquiring things that will increase your sense of well-being, they ought to also include goals to help other people in your various life roles.”（虽然你有意的志向目标将包括追求能够增加你的幸福感的事物，但它们也应该包括在你生活的各种角色中帮助他人的目标。）选项C“They should include goals to help other people.”（它们应该包括帮助他人的目标）是原文明确提到的关于有意的志向目标的要求。
analyses.15: 原文音频 00:12:50,860 --> 00:12:57,900 文章指出：“If you have nothing to strive for, you're putting yourself in the dangerous position of simply drifting through life.”（如果你没有奋斗目标，你就会把自己置于危险的境地，仅仅是随波逐流地活着。）选项A“Drifting through life aimlessly.”（漫无目的地随波逐流地活着）使用了原文中的关键短语“drifting through life”。
analyses.16: 讲座开始时，说话者提到考试和论文复习季，并指出“eating well can make a real difference to your revision regime”（吃得好能对你的复习方案产生真正的影响）。然后她提出问题：“So what brain boosting food and drink would I recommend?”（那么我会推荐什么健脑的食物和饮料呢？）（原文音频 00:15:16,579 --> 00:15:20,140）。接下来的内容详细介绍了各种有益于复习期间大脑功能的食物和饮料。因此，讲座的主要推荐是健脑的食物和饮料。选项D“Brain-boosting food and drink.”（健脑的食物和饮料）是讲座的主题。
analyses.17: 原文音频 00:15:57,600 --> 00:16:03,620 说话者对咖啡提出了具体的建议和警告：“So stop drinking coffee by 2pm and have an axiom of 2 cups of coffee a day.”（所以下午两点以后就不要喝咖啡了，每天最多喝两杯咖啡。）她警告不要在下午2点之后喝咖啡。选项C“Drinking it after 2 pm.”（下午2点以后喝咖啡）是说话者警告的内容。
analyses.18: 原文音频 00:17:01,160 --> 00:17:18,380 说话者建议：“... food should always come before supplements, and the key to getting as many nutrients as possible is to eat a very diet, with lots of different colors... It's better to get everything you need from food and drink.”（……食物应该永远优先于补充剂，获取尽可能多营养的关键是吃多样化的饮食，要有许多不同的颜色……最好从食物和饮料中获取你所需的一切。）“eat a varied diet”意为吃多样化的饮食，即食用种类丰富的食物。选项B“By consuming a rich variety of foods.”（通过食用种类丰富的食物）概括了说话者的建议。
analyses.19: 原文音频 00:19:01,320 --> 00:19:11,840 文章提到了瑞典学者Hans Rossling发现的令人担忧的趋势：“Not only do many people across advanced economies have no idea that the world is becoming a much better place, but they actually even think the opposite.”（不仅许多发达经济体的人不知道世界正在变得越来越好，他们甚至认为情况恰恰相反。）认为情况“恰恰相反”就是认为世界正在变得越来越糟。选项A“Many people across advanced economies think the world is going from bad to worse.”（许多发达经济体的人认为世界正在变得越来越糟）准确描述了这一趋势。
analyses.20: 原文音频 00:20:13,040 --> 00:20:35,800 说话者指出：“If we really care about global welfare, globalization is the only way forward to ensure that economic prosperity is shared among all countries and not only a select few advanced economies.”（如果我们真的关心全球福祉，全球化是确保经济繁荣在所有国家而非仅少数发达经济体之间共享的唯一途径。）选项C“It is the only way for all countries to share economic prosperity.”（这是所有国家共享经济繁荣的唯一途径）与原文表述一致。
analyses.21: 原文音频 00:21:47,740 --> 00:21:57,180 文章最后提到：“In fact, for the first time ever since the Industrial Revolution, about half of the global population can be considered middle class.”（事实上，自工业革命以来，全球约一半的人口首次可以被视为中产阶级。）选项B“They can be classified as middle class.”（他们可以被划归为中产阶级）直接引用了原文的结论。
analyses.22: 讲座以气味与记忆的联系开篇，然后提出了核心问题：“But why does smells sometimes trigger powerful memories, especially emotional ones?”（但为什么气味有时会触发强烈的记忆，尤其是情感记忆呢？）（原文音频 00:23:19,420 --> 00:23:25,540）。讲座的主要内容就是解释气味如何与大脑中的情感和记忆区域直接相连，从而回答了这个问题。选项A“Why smells can activate emotional memories.”（为什么气味能激活情感记忆）是讲座试图回答的核心问题。
analyses.23: 原文音频 00:23:59,240 --> 00:24:05,760 说话者解释了气味与情感和记忆之间紧密联系的原因：“Sense are the only sensations that travel such a direct path to the emotional and memory centers of the brain.”（气味是唯一一条直接通往大脑情感和记忆中心的感官通道。）正是这种直接的路径导致了它们之间的紧密联系。选项D“The sensations of scents going directly to the brain’s emotional and memory centers.”（气味的感觉直接通往大脑的情感和记忆中心）与原文描述的直接路径相符。
analyses.24: 原文音频 00:24:49,980 --> 00:24:53,680 说话者解释了为什么有时情感被触发但记忆没有出现，并说：“The explanation is context.”（解释是情境。）接着详述原因：“It will be much more difficult to recover the associated memory, because the brain uses the context to give meaning to the information and find that memory.”（恢复相关的记忆会困难得多，因为大脑使用情境来赋予信息意义并找到那个记忆。）大脑用来赋予信息意义并找到记忆的是“context”（情境）。选项D“Context.”（情境）符合原文。
analyses.25: 原文音频 00:25:22,900 --> 00:25:24,500 说话者指出气味记忆与其它记忆有共同的缺点：“not with standing, they have the same drawbacks as other memories.”（尽管如此，它们与其他记忆有着相同的缺点。）她随后具体说明这些缺点：“They aren't always accurate, and they can change over time. In fact, each time we remember something, that memory can become distorted.”（它们并不总是准确的，而且会随时间改变。事实上，每次我们回忆某件事，那个记忆都可能变得扭曲。）共同的缺点是“inaccuracy”（不准确）和“change over time”/“distorted”（可改变/扭曲），即不准确性和可变性。选项A“Inaccuracy and alterability.”（不准确性和可变性）概括了这些缺点。
analyses.26: 根据上下文，负面情绪会给构建共同理解的努力蒙上一层阴影，因此选择“shadow”。
analyses.27: 文章提到“通过赞赏、______微笑和温暖的评论撒播积极性”，需要一个形容词修饰微笑，表示友善、亲切的，故选择“affectionate”。
analyses.28: 当对话气氛升温，愤怒爆发时，对话就会从合作关系“翻转”到敌对关系。选择“flips”表示状态的快速转变。
analyses.29: 对话变成敌对关系后，进展很可能立即停止。选择“halt”表示停止、中止。
analyses.30: 文章描述不对称对话中，沉默的伙伴通常会厌倦只听不说。选择“typically”表示通常情况下。
analyses.31: 不对称对话中，说话多的人可能会感到负担过重。选择“overburdened”表示负担过重。
analyses.32: 语速和音量差异也会“侵蚀”或破坏对称性，导致一方占据更多话语权。选择“erode”表示逐渐损害、侵蚀。
analyses.33: 一个人的观点可能更有影响力，因为其表达方式更“有活力”或更具说服力。选择“vigorous”表示有活力的、强有力的。
analyses.34: 一种观点可能容易被忽视，因为它表达得更“试探性地”或不确定地。选择“tentatively”表示试探性地、不确定地。
analyses.35: 如果任何一方说话过于“占主导地位”或完全沉默，改变这种模式将会有益。选择“predominates”表示占主导地位、显著。
analyses.46: 文章第二段提到，由于缺乏就业机会，乡村居民正在迁出，“leaving the countryside in desolation”（使乡村变得荒凉），这与A选项“正在变得有些荒凉”一致。B选项“正在日益城市化”与文意不符；C和D选项是乡村生活的一些特点，但不是其现状（结果）。
analyses.47: 文章第三段指出，乡村居民使用更多能源来维护独立房屋，导致“higher carbon emissions per person than in the city”（人均碳排放量高于城市），并认为“it is actually irresponsible to endorse such a lifestyle choice”（认可这种生活方式选择实际上是不负责任的）。这表明作者认为乡村生活方式在能源效率上不如城市，与B选项一致。C选项提到乡村居民是重度汽车用户，但没有说“高度依赖大型汽车（heavy automobiles）”；D选项提到富裕的城市居民购买乡村第二居所，但这与作者对乡村生活方式整体的看法（能源效率低）不同。
analyses.48: 文章第四段提到富裕城市居民购买乡村第二居所的“副作用”是“house prices are pushed up due to increased demand, leaving them unaffordable for local people”（房价因需求增加而被推高，导致当地居民无法负担），“market forces are further forcing residents out of the countryside”（市场力量正在进一步迫使居民离开乡村）。作者认为对于“those who believe in rural preservation, this is deplorable”（那些相信乡村保护的人来说，这是令人遗憾的）。这表明作者认为这种行为不利于乡村的保护，与D选项一致。文章没有明确说它会破坏传统乡村生活（A）、影响社会稳定（B）或阻碍经济复兴（C），但明确指出了其对乡村保护的负面影响。
analyses.49: 文章第五段讨论了工业化和互联网等带来的变化，并总结说“Considering these changes, surely an evolving countryside is inevitable.”（考虑到这些变化，乡村的演变肯定是不可避免的）。这与A选项“注定会逐渐改变”一致。文章指出理想化的乡村观点与现实不同（B）；提到了互联网引入外国文化（C），但这只是变化的一部分；文章描述了变化，但没有直接说乡村会变得越来越多样化（D）。最核心的观点是变化是不可避免的。
analyses.50: 文章最后一段说：“we know that the world is going to see new cities emerging from the dust and current cities growing into megacities, but the future of the countryside is less clear.”（我们知道世界将会有新的城市兴起，现有城市将发展成特大城市，但乡村的未来则不太明朗）。这表明作者认为乡村的未来不像城市的未来那样容易预测或想象，与D选项一致。文章没有明确说对当地人会更困难（A）、会变得像城市（B）、或不太可能保持静止（C），尽管变化是不可避免的，但“less clear”强调的是其不确定性，即不容易预见。
analyses.51: 文章第一段提到：“Statements, like ‘beauty is in the eye of the beholder (观看者)’, are rarely questioned. They’ve become so embedded in our consciousness that people think it’s absurd to think otherwise.”（像“美在于观者的眼中”这样的说法，很少受到质疑。它们已如此根深蒂固地存在于我们的意识中，以至于人们认为否则的想法是荒谬的）。这与A选项“几乎从未受到争议”一致。
analyses.52: 文章第二段明确指出：“The results from this study show that people agree very much in their aesthetic evaluation of natural objects, but they disagree more about artifacts, or human-made objects.”（这项研究的结果表明，人们在对自然物体的审美评价上非常一致，但在人造物或人造物品上则分歧更大）。这与C选项“关于人造物品的共识较少”一致。A选项是普遍情况，但研究结果更具体；B选项文中未提及；D选项与研究结果部分矛盾（自然物一致，人造物不一致）。
analyses.53: 文章第五段解释了人造物品审美一致性较低的原因：“Art and architecture, unlike natural spaces, do not have the same level of exposure. So, people do not have the same level of shared taste.”（艺术和建筑，不像自然空间，没有相同的接触程度。因此，人们没有相同水平的共同品味）。这与D选项“它们出现在人们视野中的频率低于自然空间”一致。A选项多样性可能是原因之一，但文章未直接说明；B选项在第六段作为可能原因被提及，但文章并未确定是主要原因；C选项文中未提及。
analyses.54: 文章第八段以日落为例说明了自然界的美学特征：“Nature exhibits some of the universal aesthetic features such as radiance in a common way throughout the world. It’s not exactly the same everywhere, but it is common. For example, a sunset is similar enough in different places to warrant almost universal appeal.”（自然界以一种世界各地普遍的方式展现了一些普遍的美学特征，如光辉。它并非完全一样，但普遍存在。例如，日落在不同地方足够相似，以至于获得了几乎普遍的吸引力）。这与B选项“它在世界各地以相似的方式展示美学特征”一致。A选项描述了日落吸引力的一部分原因，但B选项更全面地概括了日落作为例子的作用；C和D选项过于宽泛或并非日落这个例子直接说明的结论。
analyses.55: 文章第九段解释了为什么人造物不总是具有普遍吸引力：“When people get involved in making artifacts in architecture or art, they apply these very general concepts in unique ways. But the way they applied the principle may not have universal appeal.”（当人们参与建造建筑或艺术品等人造物时，他们以独特的方式运用这些非常普遍的概念。但他们运用原则的方式可能不具有普遍吸引力）。这与C选项“它们的创作者运用美的原则的方式可能并非令所有人愉悦”一致。A选项与文章关于客观原则的讨论相悖；B选项与第九段说的“allow for a wide array of embodiments”矛盾；D选项强调创作者个人偏好，C选项更侧重于这种个人化的运用方式导致的结果，即无法获得普遍吸引力，更贴合原文。

The delicious scent of bread, for example, can act like a time machine. One sniff can bring back a memory from many years ago. Indeed, scent particles in general can revive memories that have been long forgotten. But why do smells sometimes trigger powerful memories, especially emotional ones? The short answer is that the brain regions that handle smells, memories, and emotions are linked. A scent is a chemical particle that floats in through the nose and into the region of brain responsible for smell, where the sensation is first processed into a form that the brain can read. Brain cells then carry that information to the area of the brain where emotions are processed, and then to an adjacent area of the brain where learning and memory formation take place. Since are the only sensations that travel such a direct path to the emotional and memory centers of the brain. That results in an intimate connection between emotions, memories, and sense, which is why memories triggered by sense are experienced as more emotional than those triggered by sight or sound. Let's take a closer look at how those memories are activated. Usually, when a person smells something, Meaning that's connected to a meaningful event in their past, they'll first have an emotional response to the sensation, and then a memory might follow. But sometimes the memory doesn't come to the surface. The person might feel the emotion of something that happened in the past, but won't remember what they experienced. What causes this baffling phenomenon? The explanation is context. Imagine this scenario. A person is walking down the street, smelling a scent that they first encountered decades ago, which activates an emotional response. If the person had first come across that smell in a very different context, it will be much more difficult to recover the associated memory, because the brain uses the context to give meaning to the information and find that memory. writing.sample: Nowadays, more and more students have realized the importance of self-discipline in their personal growth. This awareness stems from understanding that achieving goals, whether academic or personal, relies heavily on the ability to manage one's time, efforts, and impulses. For instance, a self-disciplined student can resist distractions like social media, prioritize studying, and stick to a demanding schedule, leading to improved academic performance. Self-discipline is also vital for developing healthy routines, such as regular exercise or proper sleep, which contribute to overall well-being. Personally, I've found that setting clear daily tasks and consistently working towards them, even when facing difficulties, requires significant self-discipline and ultimately yields better results and a stronger sense of achievement. It is this inner strength that helps students overcome challenges, stay focused on their long-term aspirations, and build a solid foundation for future success. Recognizing its value is the first step towards cultivating this essential trait.

writing.sample: College provides a great opportunity for students to explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves, far beyond just attending lectures.  This stage offers a diverse curriculum, allowing students to sample different subjects and discover hidden interests they might not have considered before.  Beyond academics, college life is rich with clubs, societies, and extracurricular activities.  Joining a debate club, volunteering for a cause, or participating in a sport can reveal strengths and passions that shape future choices.  Furthermore, interacting with peers from diverse backgrounds broadens perspectives and helps students understand different viewpoints and potential career paths.  Internships and career services also provide practical exposure to industries.  By actively engaging with these opportunities, students gain clarity about their aspirations and develop the skills needed to pursue a fulfilling career and life. It is a crucial period for self-discovery and charting one's future.

analyses.16:
原文：“The majority of cyber-loafing research focuses on ways to prevent employees from engaging in this behavior through interventions such as internet monitoring and computer use policies.”
翻译：“大多数关于网络摸鱼的研究都集中在如何通过互联网监控和计算机使用政策等干预措施来阻止员工参与这种行为。”
解释：讲座中提到，大多数关于网络摸鱼的研究关注的是“ways to prevent employees from engaging in this behavior”，意为“阻止员工参与这种行为的方式”。选项D“How to prevent employees from cyberloafing.”意为“如何阻止员工网络摸鱼”，与原文意思一致。
analyses.17:
原文：“Our hypothesis was that cyberloafing may serve as a mini break, giving employees an opportunity to recover from stress or work situations.”
翻译：“我们的假设是，网络摸鱼可能起到小憩的作用，为员工提供从压力或工作情境中恢复的机会。”
解释：讲座中，说话者明确说明了他们的研究团队的假设是“Our hypothesis was that cyberloafing may serve as a mini break, giving employees an opportunity to recover from stress or work situations.”，意为“网络摸鱼可能起到小憩的作用，为员工提供从压力或工作情境中恢复的机会。”这与选项B“网络摸鱼可以缓解员工的压力”相符。
analyses.18:
原文：“This fits with other recent research that suggests taking short breaks as associated with higher levels of daily job performance.”
翻译：“这与其他近期研究结果一致，那些研究表明短暂休息与更高的日常工作表现相关。”
解释：说话者在解释了他们研究发现网络摸鱼可能作为一种缓解压力的“relief valve”（缓解阀）后，指出这个结果“fits with other recent research that suggests taking short breaks as associated with higher levels of daily job performance.”，意为“这与其他近期研究结果一致，那些研究表明短暂休息与更高的日常工作表现相关。”他们的研究结果与“短暂休息意味着更好的工作表现”这一点与其他近期研究一致。选项A“Taking mini-breaks means better job performance.”意为“短暂休息意味着更好的工作表现”，符合原文。
analyses.19:
原文：“According to, when Julius Morton moved to Nebraska City in 1854, he faced a problem shared by many settlers in the territory. It was a treeless plane. That meant no trees for building materials, or for fuel.”
翻译：“据说，当朱利叶斯·莫顿于1854年搬到内布拉斯加市时，他面临着许多在该地区的定居者共同面临的问题。那是一片没有树木的平原。这意味着没有树木用于建筑材料或燃料。”
解释：讲座中提到，朱利叶斯·莫顿于1854年搬到内布拉斯加市时面临的问题是“It was a treeless plane.”，意为“那是一片没有树木的平原。”这直接说明了那里没有树木，与选项C“There were no trees.”（没有树）一致。
analyses.20:
原文：“As the forest grew, so did Morton's influence in Nebraska. This was largely because Morton founded the Nebraska City News, the state's first newspaper, in which he frequently wrote editorials about the practical and aesthetic benefits of tree planting.”
翻译：“随着森林的增长，莫顿在内布拉斯加州的（影响力）也随之增长。这主要是因为莫顿创办了《内布拉斯加市新闻报》，这是该州的第一份报纸，他在报纸中经常撰写关于植树的实际和美学益处的社论。”
解释：讲座中提到，莫顿影响力增加的原因是“largely because Morton founded the Nebraska City News, the state's first newspaper, in which he frequently wrote editorials about the practical and aesthetic benefits of tree planting.”，意为“主要是因为莫顿创办了该州第一份报纸《内布拉斯加市新闻报》，他在报纸中经常撰写关于植树的社论”。这与选项D“他创办了一份报纸并用它来宣传他的想法”相符。
analyses.21:
原文：“The state government agreed, and on April 10th 1872, the first unofficial Arbor Day was celebrated throughout Nebraska. Prizes were awarded to counties, cities, and individuals, who planted the largest number of trees. That day, an astounding 1 million trees were planted in Nebraska,”
翻译：“州政府同意了，于是在1872年4月10日，全内布拉斯加州庆祝了第一个非官方的植树节。对种植树木数量最多的县、市和个人进行了奖励。那天，内布拉斯加州种植了惊人的100万棵树。”
解释：讲座中描述1872年4月10日发生了什么：“on April 10th 1872, the first unofficial Arbor Day was celebrated throughout Nebraska... That day, an astounding 1 million trees were planted in Nebraska,”，意为“1872年4月10日，全内布拉斯加州庆祝了第一个非官方的植树节……那天，内布拉斯加州种植了惊人的100万棵树。”选项B“全内布拉斯加州种植了100万棵树”是那天发生的一个重要事实，并且明确在原文中提到。选项A不对，奖励给了种植数量最多的人或单位，不是莫顿个人。选项C不对，那天是非官方的，合法节日是1885年。选项D不对，获得绰号是后来的事情。因此选项B符合原文。
analyses.22:
原文：“Modern humans arose in Africa about 200,000 years ago. They then spread across Europe and Asia sometime after 60,000 years ago. This is the out of Africa model, as it's commonly known. In the 1990s, the hypothesis found widespread acceptance.”
翻译：“现代人类大约在20万年前起源于非洲。然后，他们在大约6万年前的某个时间扩散到欧洲和亚洲。这就是通常所知的‘走出非洲’模式。在20世纪90年代，这一假说得到了广泛接受。”
解释：讲座中介绍了20世纪90年代普遍接受的“走出非洲”模式，该模式认为现代人类起源于非洲，并“sometime after 60,000 years ago”（大约6万年前的某个时间）扩散到欧洲和亚洲。选项D“他们大约在6万年前走出非洲”与这一定义相符。
analyses.23:
原文：“But this popular idea is in need of revision, particularly given the number of important findings across Asia over the past few decades. For instance, many new human fossils found, particularly in China, are now dated as older than 60,000 years. This calls into question the idea that modern humans migrated out of Africa only 60,000 years ago. Take the recent discovery of two modern human teeth found in the Lunar Cave in China's Guangxi Zhuang or telnomu's region. When my research team and I dated these teeth, we found they were more than 70,000 years old.”
翻译：“但这个流行的想法需要修订，特别是考虑到过去几十年在亚洲的许多重要发现。例如，在亚洲，特别是在中国发现的许多新人化石现在被定为早于6万年。这使得现代人类仅在6万年前走出非洲的观点受到了质疑。以最近在中国广西壮族自治区的隆那洞穴中发现的两颗现代人牙齿为例。我和我的研究团队对这些牙齿进行测定后发现，它们的历史超过7万年。”
解释：讲座中提到，“走出非洲”模式受到质疑的原因是“许多重要发现”，特别是“在亚洲，特别是在中国发现的许多新人化石现在被定为早于6万年”。随后举例说明了在中国隆那洞穴发现的“两颗现代人牙齿”，经测定有7万多年历史，这“使得现代人类仅在6万年前走出非洲的观点受到了质疑”。因此，在中国发现的现代人牙齿等化石是质疑该模式的关键。选项A“在中国发现的两颗现代人牙齿”是具体质疑的例子，符合原文意思。
analyses.24:
原文：“If a population is perfectly adapted to a particular environment and has access to an abundance of resources, Then there really is no reason to move or change. For instance, some monkeys in Africa have a set of teeth that has hardly changed over the course of millions of years, indicating that they found a place that has worked for them. So what happened with humans?”
翻译：“如果一个种群完全适应了特定的环境，并且拥有丰富的资源，那么真的没有理由迁移或改变。例如，非洲的一些猴子的牙齿在数百万年里几乎没有变化，这表明它们找到了适合它们生存的地方。那么人类呢？”
解释：说话者引用非洲猴子的例子，说明如果一个物种完全适应环境且资源充足，就不会迁移或改变。然后反问“那么人类呢？”，引出人类迁移的原因探讨。这个例子是为了说明，人类的迁移必然是因为某种原因，环境不再完美适应或资源不再丰富，从而有“reason to move or change”（迁移或改变的理由）。选项A“人类迁移肯定有某种原因”是这个例子想要表明的主旨，符合原文逻辑。
analyses.25:
原文：“Humans need daily access to reliable fresh water, which appears to be absent from many coastal areas. This brings us to another question, by which route did modern humans move out of Africa? No clear routes across the Mediterranean from North Africa appear to be present. So the earlier dispersals out of Africa and into Europe and Asia might have across the Arabian Peninsula.”
翻译：“人类每天都需要获得可靠的淡水，而许多沿海地区似乎缺乏淡水。这就引出了另一个问题：现代人类是沿着哪条路线走出非洲的？似乎没有从北非穿过地中海的清晰路线。所以早期走出非洲进入欧洲和亚洲的扩散可能是跨越阿拉伯半岛。”
解释：讲座接近尾声时，说话者提到了淡水的重要性，然后引出了一个新的问题：“This brings us to another question, by which route did modern humans move out of Africa?”，意为“这就引出了另一个问题：现代人类是沿着哪条路线走出非洲的？”随后探讨了可能的路线（跨越阿拉伯半岛）。选项C“现代人类走出非洲走了哪条路线”与这个新提出的问题一致。
analyses.46: 文章第一段提到，尽管我们在保护孩子方面非常细致，但有一个群体“几乎不受限制地接触孩子”，而这个群体“根本没有把孩子的最大利益放在心上”。第二段紧接着说明，我们似乎认为广告商和营销人员被允许影响最小的孩子（advertisers and marketers are allowed to condition even the youngest children）。综合这两段，这个对孩子有不受限接触且不顾孩子利益的群体就是广告商和营销人员。
analyses.47: 文章第二段批评了广告将孩子的身份和自我价值与物质关联，让他们向外部事物寻求认可。作者认为，“我们正在培养小消费者，而不是那些因为他们对生活在其中的社会做出贡献而珍视自己的年轻公民。”（We're turning out little consumers rather than young citizens who will value themselves for what they contribute to the society in which they live.）这句话直接表明了作者希望孩子成为B选项描述的那种人。
analyses.48: 文章第四段提到，“许多心理学家、儿童发展专家和教育工作者指出，研究表明这种正在出现的终生消费主义正在导致低自尊、抑郁症和其他形式心理疾病的发病率上升。”（Many psychologists, child development experts and educators point to research suggesting that this emerging cradle-to-grave consumerism is contributing to growing rates of low self-esteem, depression and other forms of mental illness.）这与A选项“终生消费主义导致越来越多的心理问题”一致。
analyses.49: 文章第五段提到广告商和营销人员“永远在开发新方法来说服我们的孩子渴望物质财产，而且因为广告的病毒式效应（viral effect），他们只需要感染少数人就能影响到大多数人。”（because of advertisements' viral effect they only need to infect a few to reach the many.）这里的“病毒式效应”和“只需感染少数人就能影响大多数人”暗示了广告的影响具有感染性，能从少数人扩散到多数人，符合A选项“它实际上对许多人具有感染性，而不仅仅是少数人”的意思。选项C虽然提到了“病毒式效应”，但原文说的是一种“效应”，而非广告本身“可与病毒相比”，A更贴近原文的含义。
analyses.50: 文章第七段提到了反对彻底禁止向11岁以下儿童做广告的反对意见。其中一种观点是“这将是对言论自由的侵犯，并侵犯公司向小朋友进行洗脑从而让他们要求购买自己产品的权利。”（That would be a breach of freedom of speech and infringe the rights of corporations to brainwash little children into demanding their products.）D选项“它将侵犯广告商被赋予的权利”正是对原文中“侵犯公司的权利”的概括。
analyses.51: 文章第一段指出，“许多人反对工作场所监控，因为它具有固有的非人化效应以及带来的无情压力。”（Many oppose workplace surveillance, because of the inherent dehumanizing effect it has and the relentless pressure it brings.）这里的“无情压力”（relentless pressure）与A选项“它让员工持续承受压力”相符。
analyses.52: 文章第二段描述了监控技术的细节，并指出，“虽然这可能听起来有侵犯性，但支持者认为它也能保护员工免受欺凌和性骚扰。”（While this may sound intrusive, exponents argue that it can also protect employees against bullying and sexual harassment.）D选项“它可以保护员工免受攻击性行为”是对“保护员工免受欺凌和性骚扰”的概括，符合支持者的论点。
analyses.53: 文章第三段以午餐桌人数为例，说明“这种数据分析可以产生意想不到的结果。”（Some of this data analysis can produce unexpected results.）接着详细描述了这个例子（12人桌比4人桌更能促进互动、想法分享和表现），并指出“如果没有这样的数据分析，这一事实可能不会被发现”。因此，作者引用此例是为了说明通过数据分析可以得到一些意想不到的发现，与B选项一致。
analyses.54: 文章第六段结尾和第七段指出，监控工具是否会不受欢迎很大程度上取决于如何传达这些监控措施（A lot depends on how such monitoring initiatives are communicated）。如果老板沟通不畅，员工会做最坏的打算；但如果公开收集的信息及其用途，研究表明大多数员工是可以接受的（If bosses don't communicate effectively, employees assume the worst. But if they're open about the information they're collecting and what they're doing with it, research suggests 46% of employees are generally okay with it.）。这表明监控措施的积极效果很大程度上取决于老板如何清楚地告知监控的目的和方式，与D选项“老板如何很好地告知其监控目的”一致。
analyses.55: 文章第七段提到，尽管许多监控方案使用匿名数据且员工参与是自愿的，但许多员工仍然怀疑，并担心他们的公民自由受到侵蚀（many staffers remain sceptical and fear an erosion of their civil liberties.）。这里的“侵蚀他们的公民自由”与C选项“他们可能侵犯员工应有的自由”相符。

So he started planting trees beginning with his own land. By 1860, Morton possessed a forest of more than 300 trees. A few years later, he had more than 1000. Morton called the special event, Arbor Day, as Arbor is Latin for Tree. The state government agreed, and on April 10th 1872, the first unofficial Arbor Day was celebrated throughout Nebraska. They then spread across Europe and Asia sometime after 60,000 years ago. This is the out of Africa model, as it's commonly known. In the 1990s, the hypothesis found widespread acceptance. But this popular idea is in need of revision, particularly given the number of important findings across Asia over the past few decades. For instance, many new human fossils found, particularly in China, are now dated as older than 60,000 years. This calls into question the idea that modern humans migrated out of Africa only 60,000 years ago. Take the recent discovery of two modern human teeth found in the Lunar Cave in China's Guangxi Zhuang or telnomu's region. When my research team and I dated these teeth, we found they were more than 70,000 years old. A situation clearly impossible if modern humans moved out of Africa only 60,000 years ago. So, with such findings, what happened exactly? Where does the most current data suggest we came from? The first question we should ask is, why did modern humans leave Africa to begin with? If a population is perfectly adapted to a particular environment and has access to an abundance of resources, Then there really is no reason to move or change. For instance, some monkeys in Africa have a set of teeth that has hardly changed over the course of millions of years, indicating that they found a place that has worked for them. So what happened with humans? Some researchers have suggested that population density increased to the point where small human groups were forced to explore new lands. Other researchers have suggested that due to major environmental events in East Africa, humans were prompted to find greener pastures. Yet another explanation could simply be that early modern human hunters were following the large animals that they relied on. And so they moved out of Africa without realizing that they were actually moving from one continent to another. Humans need daily access to reliable fresh water, which appears to be absent from many coastal areas. This brings us to another question, by which route did modern humans move out of Africa? translation.reference: With the rapid development of China's economy and the steady improvement of people's living standards, urban residents' demands for the environment and quality of life are increasing. Chinese local governments are paying more attention to the construction and improvement of public facilities to better meet people's needs. By building new squares, parks, and public green spaces or by replanning and renovating existing public areas, many cities have provided citizens with more venues for leisure and social activities. Nowadays, government-funded fitness equipment and laid-out fitness trails can be found everywhere in many cities, which have significantly improved the conditions for citizens' outdoor activities and have made the cities more beautiful.

analyses.55: 文章最后一句说：“下次当你听到有人热情地争辩说每个人都应该拥抱不墨守成规并避免模仿他人时，你可能会有点想笑。毕竟，我们不是黑猩猩。” 这句话是在前面的论述（人类倾向于模仿，甚至是非理性模仿，而黑猩猩更理性）之后提出的。作者通过说“我们不是黑猩猩”来强调，与更理性的黑猩猩不同，人类的特点就是模仿他人。因此，作者强调的是模仿是人类的特点。

translation.prompt: 随着经济与社会的发展，中国人口结构发生了显著变化，逐渐步入老龄化社会。中国老年人口将持续增加，人口老龄化趋势将更加明显。为了应对人口老龄化带来的种种挑战，国家正积极采取措施，加大对养老的支持。通过改革社会保障(social security)制度，政府不断增加社会保障经费，逐步扩大社会保障覆盖范围，使更多老年人受益。政府还鼓励各种社会团体为老年人提供服务。在政府和社会团体的共同努力下，老年人将生活得更加幸福。
translation.reference: With the development of economy and society, China's population structure has undergone significant changes, gradually entering an aging society. The elderly population in China will continue to increase, and the trend of population aging will become more pronounced. To address the various challenges brought by population aging, the government is actively taking measures to strengthen support for the elderly. By reforming the social security system, the government is continuously increasing social security funds and gradually expanding the scope of social security coverage to benefit more elderly people. The government also encourages various social organizations to provide services for the elderly. With the joint efforts of the government and social organizations, the elderly will live happier lives.

writing.sample: Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence. This realization reflects a shift from overprotective parenting towards enabling children to develop essential life skills through practical experience. When children are given opportunities to make their own decisions, solve minor problems, and navigate social interactions with less direct adult intervention, they learn valuable lessons about consequences, responsibility, and self-reliance. For example, allowing a child to choose their own book at the library, manage their allowance, or figure out how to assemble a simple toy encourages them to think critically and trust their judgment. Completing tasks independently, even small ones like packing their own schoolbag or preparing a simple snack, provides a sense of achievement that significantly boosts their self-esteem. This freedom to explore their interests, whether through unstructured play or pursuing a hobby, allows them to discover their strengths and passions, further solidifying their confidence. Ultimately, this approach prepares them to be adaptable, resilient, and confident individuals capable of navigating the complexities of adulthood.
writing.prompt: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words not including the sentence given).

translation.prompt: 近年来，中国老龄人口持续增长。中国政府正采取各种措施，推进养老服务体系建设，使老年人晚年生活健康幸福。全国兴建了各类养老服务机构。为了提升养老机构的服务质量，政府颁布了一系列标准，加强对养老机构的监管。许多城市为方便老年人用餐，开设了社区食堂，为他们提供价格实惠的饭菜。行动不便的老年人还能享受上门送餐服务。同时，中国还在积极探索居家和社区养老等其他养老模式，以确保所有老年人老有所养。
translation.reference: In recent years, China's elderly population has continued to grow. The Chinese government is implementing various measures to advance the construction of the elderly care service system, aiming to ensure a healthy and happy life for seniors in their later years. Various types of elderly care service institutions have been established nationwide. To enhance the service quality of these institutions, the government has issued a series of standards and strengthened their regulation. Many cities have opened community canteens to offer affordable meals for the convenience of the elderly, and those with mobility difficulties can also receive doorstep meal delivery services. Simultaneously, China is actively exploring other elderly care models, such as home-based and community-based care, to guarantee that all elderly people are cared for.

analyses.46: 文章第一段首句即指出“The suggestion that people should aim for dietary diversity by trying to eat a variety of foods has been a basic public health recommendation for decades”，这与选项A“人们应该多样化他们的饮食”一致。
analyses.47: 文章第一段描述了美国心脏协会的新研究发现：“Researchers reviewed all the evidence published related to dietary diversity and saw a correlation between dietary diversity and a greater intake of both healthy and unhealthy foods.”并且“researchers found a greater prevalence of obesity amongst people with a greater dietary diversity.”，这表明多样化饮食与更高的食物摄入量（包括健康和不健康食物）以及肥胖有关，因此选择C，“追求多样化饮食的人倾向于吃更多食物”。
analyses.48: 文章第二段指出，“But this advice does not seem to be supported by science, possibly because there is little agreement about the meaning of 'dietary diversity,' which is not clearly and consistently defined.”，这解释了新发现与标准饮食建议矛盾的原因可能是对“多样化饮食”的定义缺乏一致性，这与选项A一致。
analyses.49: 文章第三段提到Dr. Rao的观察：“after 20 years of experience in the field of obesity, he has observed that people who have a regimented lifestyle and diet tend to be thinner and healthier than people with a wide variety of consumption.”他还指出，研究发现“no evidence that dietary diversity promotes healthy body weight or optimal eating patterns.”，这表明多样化食物摄入可能不利于健康体重，与选项B“多样化食物摄入可能不利于健康”的意思相符。
analyses.50: 文章第三段末尾提到，“Further, there is some evidence that a greater variety of food options in a single meal may delay people's feeling of fullness and actually increase how much they eat.”，这意味着食物种类越多，人们越不容易感到饱，从而可能吃得更多，直到过量。这与选项C“他们直到吃得过多才感到足够”相符。
analyses.51: 文章第一段开篇即指出“The ability to make inferences from same and different, once thought to be unique to humans...”，意思是根据相同和不同进行推断的能力，曾被认为是人类独有的。这与选项A“能够进行相同-不同区分”一致。
analyses.52: 文章第二段引用实验心理学家Edward Wasserman的话说：“The study, published Thursday in Science, challenges our idea of what it means to have a birdbrain... In fact, birds are extremely intelligent...”，这里的“birdbrain”通常用来形容笨，所以挑战“what it means to have a birdbrain”就是挑战认为鸟笨的观点，也就是认为我们对鸟类智力的看法是错误的，这与选项D一致。
analyses.53: 文章第六段描述实验结果：“The researchers found that about 70% of the ducklings preferred to move toward the pair of objects that had the same shape or color relationship as the first objects they saw.”实验设计是让小鸭子看到两组物品，第一组物品内部是“same”或“different”的关系，然后给它们看两组新的物品，一组物品内部是“same”关系，另一组是“different”关系。结果表明大多数小鸭子会选择关系与第一次看到相同的物品组。这证明它们能够识别物品之间的“相同”或“不同”关系，也就是能够区分物品是否相同，与选项B一致。
analyses.54: 文章倒数第三段提到“Previous studies have suggested that other animals... can discern same from different, but only after extensive training.”，而紧接着下一段说“Adding ducklings to the list- particularly untrained newborn ducklings- suggests that...”，这突出强调了这项研究的创新之处在于使用了“untrained newborn ducklings”（未经训练的新生小鸭子），这与其他动物需要训练才能表现出相同-不同区分能力不同，与选项C一致。
analyses.55: 文章最后一段引用Dr. Wasserman的话说：“Ifs clear from this study and others like it that '"animals process and appreciate far more of the intricacies in their world than we've ever understood... "We are in a revolutionary phase in terms of our ability to understand the minds of other animals.”这里的“revolutionary phase”意为“革命性阶段”，表明我们在理解动物思维方面的能力正经历巨大飞跃，也就是正在取得显著进展，这与选项D“正在取得显著进展”一致。
